name: Control cab and shooting panel
function: The operator station with winch controls, depth and tension displays, the collar locator readout, and the shooting panel that supplies firing current to the guns and setting tool.

tabs.overview: The cab has a clear view of the stack. The shooting panel is a keyed power supply that fires only when armed by the operator and when the addressable switch selected downhole is the one intended. Depth is the measurement head count corrected to casing collars.
tabs.engineering: Firing current, safety interlocks, and radio-silence procedures per API RP 67 and the service company practice.
tabs.safety: The shooting panel key and the arming sequence are the controls against unintended firing; the panel is disabled during rig-up and any surface work on the guns.
tabs.evidence: Public pressure control equipment catalogs and service descriptions (S6, S7, S13); API RP 67 (S14) and API RP 19B (S15) for the perforating side; field practice (S9).

hazards.control: Radio silence and RF-safe systems per the site plan; licensed personnel; no one in front of loaded guns.
